description.value: Choose one, permanently. Break It — turn on your patron and tear a portion of its power free by force. You keep a permanent fraction of what it gave you, but the god is now diminished and will never forgive you; it has all the time in the world to plan around that. Fulfill It — give yourself over completely. You become your patron's herald in the mortal world: permanent, dramatic power, and a standing obligation to its will that follows you for the rest of the campaign.
